name: Real Madrid
historical_summary: The most successful club in Champions League history. Real Madrid have dominated the competition with their 'never-say-die' mentality and legendary managers like Carlo Ancelotti and Zinedine Zidane.

name: Barcelona
historical_summary: Barcelona's golden era under Pep Guardiola produced the greatest club side ever seen. They redefined football with tiki-taka and produced four of the world's best attacking players simultaneously.

name: AC Milan
historical_summary: One of Europe's greatest clubs with a defensive legacy. AC Milan's back line under Carlo Ancelotti was impenetrable, led by legendary defender Paolo Maldini.

name: Bayern Munich
historical_summary: German powerhouses who have consistently challenged for Europe's top prize. From the 70s to the 2020s, Bayern Munich remain one of the continent's most formidable forces.

name: Liverpool
historical_summary: The Miracle of Istanbul defined Liverpool's modern era. From their 70s and 80s dynasty to Klopp's resurrection, they remain one of English football's greatest institutions.

name: Manchester United
historical_summary: Sir Alex Ferguson's Manchester United won their third European Cup in a dramatic penalty shootout in Moscow. A team built on resilience and attacking flair.

name: Inter Milan
historical_summary: José Mourinho's Inter Milan completed an historic treble in 2010. Built on defensive excellence and devastating counter-attacks, they remains a masterclass in tactical football.

name: Chelsea
historical_summary: Chelsea's 2012 triumph was one of the most unlikely European Cup wins ever. Roberto Di Matteo's side defied all odds before Thomas Tuchel led them to another glory in 2021.

name: Manchester City
historical_summary: Pep Guardiola finally ended Manchester City's Champions League quest in Istanbul 2023, completing a historic treble. An achievement that crowned his managerial legacy.

name: FC Porto
historical_summary: José Mourinho's FC Porto side won the 2004 Champions League as a genuine underdog, shocking Europe with their defensive solidity and attacking prowess. One of football's greatest managerial achievements.

name: Paris Saint-Germain
historical_summary: After years of heartbreak and near-misses, PSG finally claimed the Champions League in 2025 under Luis Enrique. They became only the second club to defend the trophy in 2026.
